Specialist in cancers of the digestive tract, senior physician of the oncology department

The oncologist Sharon Peles is a well-known specialist in the diagnosis and treatment of cancers of the digestive tract. In more than fifteen years of practice she has helped many patients overcome their illness and return to ordinary life. Patients come to her from all over Israel and from abroad. Where a patient is unable to travel to Israel for treatment, she gives video consultations, offering her opinion on whether the diagnosis is correct and proposing a plan of cancer treatment. Her colleagues have recognised her high level of skill: she holds the post of senior physician in the oncology department of the Ichilov clinic.

In treating tumours of the digestive tract she uses both traditional methods and innovative approaches that have already proved highly effective. She is skilled in working with high-precision treatment and diagnostic equipment.

Alongside her clinical practice, Sharon Peles is engaged in research. Her work concerns molecular studies of cancer of the bile ducts and ovaries, and the treatment of carcinomas.

Specialisation:

  • Diagnosis and treatment of benign and malignant tumours of the digestive tract

Education: she took her basic medical degree at Ben-Gurion University in Israel and then completed an internship at Sourasky, one of Israel's largest clinics.

Clinical experience: she has completed fellowships at major medical centres — Soroka in Israel and the Royal Marsden hospital in London. She was then invited to work in the oncology department of the Sourasky medical centre. She is currently senior physician in the oncology department of the Ichilov clinic and consults as an oncologist at leading Israeli clinics, Assuta and Herzliya among them.

Research and teaching: Sharon Peles's research interests lie in cancers of the digestive tract. She has published more than ten papers on the treatment of cancer in leading medical journals and takes part in scientific conferences in Israel and internationally. She is a member of the teaching staff of the medical department at Tel Aviv University and belongs to the professional organisations of Israeli oncologists and radiotherapists.

Plastic surgeon

Dr Yaakov Bar is one of Israel's leading experts in aesthetic and plastic surgery, with extensive experience of operating across the field.

Education and clinical experience

Dr Bar graduated with distinction from the medical school of the faculty of medicine at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem in 1983. He completed his surgical training at several Israeli hospitals: Kaplan in Rehovot, Assaf Harofeh and the Meir hospital. He specialised in plastic medicine at the Soroka hospital, where he worked as a senior physician until 2001, after which he moved to the Shaare Zedek hospital in Jerusalem.

Dr Bar has considerable experience and has performed thousands of operations across aesthetic and plastic surgery.

Continuing education and courses

  • Course in the fundamentals of microsurgery, Assaf Harofeh hospital
  • Seminar on lasers in aesthetic surgery, Zurich, Switzerland, 1996
  • Course in laser safety, Soroka hospital, 1998
  • Study of facial surgery with Dr Baraf, Paris, 2005
  • Course in body lift technique with Dr Pascal, Lyon, 2006

Membership of professional associations

  • Israel Society of Plastic Surgery
  • ISAPS — International Society of Aesthetic Plastic Surgery

Why choose Israel for plastic surgery?

Israeli specialists such as Dr Yaakov Bar are highly qualified and widely experienced, which allows them to guarantee patients safety and excellent aesthetic results. The advantages of choosing Israeli clinics for plastic surgery:

  • Use of advanced techniques and technologies
  • A high level of skill and experience among surgeons
  • A short period of recovery
  • A comprehensive approach to diagnosis and treatment, including consultations and follow-up

Dr Yaakov Bar and his team take an individual approach to every patient, which allows the best results in aesthetic and plastic surgery.

Specialisation: oncology, chemotherapy, radiotherapy

Main areas of specialisation:

Dr Yulia Grinberg is a leading Israeli oncologist of international standing, specialising in the treatment of various forms of cancer and of metastatic disease. She has considerable experience and knowledge in chemotherapy and in biological and targeted treatment, applying the most modern methods and technologies in cancer care. She has 30 years of experience.

  • Breast cancer
  • Cancer of the uterus and its appendages
  • Cancers of the digestive system
  • Kidney cancer
  • Cancer of the ureter
  • Cancer of the urethra
  • Prostate cancer
  • Skin cancer

Summary:

Dr Yulia Grinberg is a recognised expert of world class in oncology. She makes active use of innovative diagnostic tools and the newest technologies, such as genetic tests and molecular studies, to draw up individually tailored chemotherapy plans that take possible side effects into account. Dr Grinberg also specialises in palliative care aimed at relieving distressing symptoms in seriously ill cancer patients.

Dr Grinberg is not only an outstanding clinician but is also actively engaged in research. She speaks regularly at international seminars and conferences, shares her experience with colleagues abroad and lectures to staff of major pharmaceutical companies. She is the author of more than 20 research papers published in prestigious international journals.

Education:

  • Doctor of Medicine (MD) from a medical university
  • Fellowship in clinical oncology at the leading clinics Ichilov and Tel HaShomer, Israel

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English
  • Russian

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Medical Association (IMA)
  • Israel Society of Clinical Oncology and Radiation Therapy (ISCORT)
  • American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO)
  • European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO)

Dr Yulia Grinberg is known for her advanced methods of treatment and her significant contribution to oncology, thanks to which many patients have received medical care of the highest quality and improved their quality of life.

Specialisation:

  • Obstetrics and gynaecology
  • Treatment of infertility
  • Assisted reproductive technologies
  • In vitro fertilisation
  • Ovarian tissue transplantation

Professor Dor has practised for many years in the United Kingdom while also researching reproductive mechanisms and taking an active part in studies of human germ cells. In 1982 he became the first Israeli doctor to perform in vitro fertilisation. His work is widely known in the international medical community thanks to his rich clinical experience and his research into restoring fertility and the use of assisted reproductive technologies.

One of the doctor's key specialisations is preserving the ability to bear children in women facing cancer.

Education:

  • Doctor of Medicine, faculty of medicine, Tel Aviv University
  • Specialist training at the faculty of medicine, University of Bern, Switzerland
  • Fellowship in obstetrics and gynaecology at the Sheba Medical Centre, Israel
  • Specialist training in IVF in the department of reproductive biology, Royal Medical College, Edinburgh, United Kingdom

Academic experience:

  • Professor in the department of reproductive technologies, Tel Aviv University
  • Together with Professor Shlomo Mashiach, founded the country's first IVF centre at the Sheba Medical Centre
  • In 1981 performed the first successful IVF procedure in Israel
  • Together with Professors Shlomo Mashiach and David Levran, founded the first private fertility centre at the Assuta hospital (1987)
  • In 2005 performed the world's first fertilisation following autotransplantation of a frozen fragment of ovary
  • In 2008 performed the country's first successful IVM procedure (in vitro maturation), which led to the birth of healthy twins
  • Author of many research papers on innovations in the treatment of infertility and in improving the effectiveness of IVF

Membership of professional organisations:

Professor Dor takes an active part in international conferences on infertility, IVF and the restoration of the ability to bear children. He is also chairman of the association for the study of the fertile years and the author of many papers published in international medical journals.

Dr Dov Laxman is a leading Israeli gynaecological surgeon and a specialist of world class in endoscopic gynaecological operations. An experienced doctor with many years of clinical practice, he has thousands of successful minimally traumatic operations on the pelvic organs to his name. He successfully removes benign and malignant growths of the uterus and its appendages and carries out surgical treatment of infections and inflammatory conditions such as bartholinitis and salpingitis. The many positive reports from his grateful patients are the best confirmation of the quality of his work.

The doctor's main areas of specialisation:

  • Gynaecological surgery
  • Endoscopic operations in gynaecology
  • Intimate surgery
  • Treatment of bartholinitis, salpingitis and hydrosalpinx
  • Removal of tumours of the uterus and its appendages

The doctor's education and clinical experience:

  • Hebrew University of Jerusalem — graduated from the faculty of medicine
  • Hadassah hospital, Jerusalem — fellowship in general surgery
  • Lis maternity hospital at the Ichilov medical centre — fellowship in gynaecology
  • Christian-Albrecht University in Kiel, Germany — fellowship in endoscopic gynaecological surgery
  • Laser Vaginal Rejuvenation Institute, Los Angeles, USA — fellowship in intimate surgery

Membership of professional associations:

  • Israel Association of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists
  • American Association of Gynecologic Laparoscopists
  • Israel Fertility Association
  • Israel Society of Gynaecological Endoscopy
  • European Society of Human Reproduction and Embryology

Professor Dov Weinberger is a recognised expert in ophthalmology with an impressive education and many years of experience. The main aspects of his professional work are as follows:

Education:

  • Technion medical school, Haifa.
  • MSc in healthcare systems management with distinction, Ben-Gurion University, Beersheba.
  • Residency in the ophthalmology department of the Rabin medical centre.
  • Diseases and surgical treatment of the retina, Cornell University, New York, USA.

Academic work:

  • Professor in the department of ophthalmology, Sackler School of Medicine, Tel Aviv University.

Membership of professional organisations:

  • Israel Medical Association.
  • Israel Ophthalmological Society.
  • Israel Society for Eye and Vision Research.
  • American Society of Retina Specialists (ASRS), USA.
  • Association for Research in Vision and Ophthalmology (ARVO).
  • Jules Gonin Club, the society for research into the macula, Switzerland.
  • International society for ocular neovascularisation, the Michaelson Club.

Areas of professional interest:

  • Diseases of the retina.
  • Biotechnology.
  • Surgery.

Clinical experience:

  • More than 30 years of experience across ophthalmology.
  • Participation in Ministry of Foreign Affairs delegations to developing countries as an ophthalmic surgeon.

Research work:

  • Head of a research laboratory at the Felsenstein research centre, Tel Aviv University.
  • Development of models simulating various diseases of the retina and their treatment.
